action_items: FIX (CRITICAL): In /app/frontend/src/pages/Messages.jsx remove the dead 'Qruplar' section (lines 177-195) that references undefined `groups` array. Since conversations with is_group=true already flow through `filteredConvs`, simply delete that block. Alternatively, derive `const groups = conversations.filter(c => c.is_group)` and `const oneToOnes = conversations.filter(c => !c.is_group)` and render them in two separate sections — but the simplest fix is removing the leftover block. After fix, /messages page should render, 'Yeni qrup' button must be visible, and group creation (POST /api/messages/conversations with participant_ids+name) should attach the new group to the sidebar via its conv.is_group rendering (using `getOtherName` which already returns conv.name for is_group=true).

After fix, re-run only the Messages smoke: open /messages → click 'Yeni qrup' → fill name + select 1 user → click 'create-group-btn' → expect group to appear in sidebar with name. Also click a group/conv → click paperclip → ensure file picker opens; backend already accepts attachment-only messages.

rca of the issue: Messages.jsx ReferenceError 'groups is not defined': The component at some point used a separate `groups` state (likely from a `/api/groups` endpoint) that was later removed/refactored into using `conversations` with `is_group` flag. The fetch and useState for `groups` were deleted but the JSX rendering block at lines 177-195 was overlooked. React JSX expressions are evaluated lazily so this compiles fine but throws at runtime on first render. Mitigation: delete the block OR derive `const groups = conversations.filter(c => c.is_group)` at the top of the render. Recommend the latter to keep the visual separation between groups and 1-1 chats, and also filter out is_group items from `filteredConvs` to avoid double rendering.
